method: Independently join every deployed DraftKings source selection ID to a fresh public Ontario selection, market and event. Expected prices, lines, availability and sides use raw fields; market names use source marketType.name, and event identity uses participant shortName/venueRole plus source kickoff. No application normalizer or model helper is called.
transport: native Node fetch, public request without account cookies or personal credentials
limits: A timestamped consistency check is not a guarantee of perpetual correctness; source and board requests are sequential, not perfectly simultaneous.
All source events in this capture are pregame. This does not prove in-play correctness, suspension delivery latency, or bookmaker-to-screen latency.
The raw source reference was fetched from the local verifier while the compared board is the public cloud deployment.
